confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on four web searches. One was for the RBA rate and three were for Bangkok prices, using aggregated cost-of-living sources (Numbeo-derived Expatica data from June 2026, Expat Arrivals from January 2026, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, Where and When) and published 2025-2026 bar and hotel menus. I converted baht to USD at roughly 32-33 THB per USD, which is my own assumption and not a searched rate. The restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors are the most reliable. The sources mostly agree: an inexpensive meal is about THB 100-125, a cappuccino about THB 85-100 and a restaurant draught beer about THB 100. A mid-range meal for two is about THB 900-1,100, though sources range from about THB 600 to 2,000. Cocktail and wine prices vary a lot. Hotel bars charge THB 340-700 for cocktails and THB 350-480 for wine, plus 17% service charge and VAT. Independent bars start around THB 300 for cocktails, and local bars are cheaper. I estimated toward the independent and mid-range end, so these two anchors are less certain. Accommodation anchors are my own estimates from general knowledge. July is low and rainy season, so I assumed moderate rates. I did not search accommodation prices or check live listings. Prices can be much higher in Sukhumvit and riverside areas than in budget districts such as Khao San.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bangkok-specific aggregated data was available for food and drink. Accommodation was benchmarked against typical Southeast Asian capital pricing such as Kuala Lumpur and Ho Chi Minh City, adjusted for Bangkok's large, competitive hostel and three-star hotel supply.
